home.practice_deflectors_blurb: Tap a mirror to flip it. Route every beam to the port that wears its sign before the count runs out, by the longest way you can find.
deflectors.title: Deflectors
deflectors.how_to: Beams come in from the ports on the edge, one at first and two together later. Tap a mirror to flip it, and route each beam to the port that wears its sign. When the count round an entry runs out the volley fires; tap a lit entry to fire it now and bring the next one sooner. A beam that gets home scores by the mirrors it turned at: turns plus one, squared. A beam out anywhere else hits the hull and costs 40.
deflectors.how_to_keyboard: Arrows or WASD move the cursor, space or enter flips the mirror under it, F fires the volley.
deflectors.lines_note: A beam that is not home yet draws a broken line to where it would leave. The dots run back from its exit. Where the two cross at a mirror, flipping that mirror joins them.
deflectors.streak_note: A volley with every beam home builds a streak that multiplies the next clean volley, up to double. The strip over the grid says what the volley is worth now and the best it could be; a volley worth its best is perfect and scores half as much again.
deflectors.hint_note: Practice rounds pulse the next mirror to flip when you pause.
deflectors.legend_entry: Entry: a solid sign with the count round it. Tap it to fire the volley now.
deflectors.legend_exit: Exit: the same sign as an outline. It fills when the beam is home.
deflectors.legend_mirror: Mirror. Tap to flip it; a beam turns at every mirror it meets.
deflectors.legend_home: A lit line with beads: the beam is home.
deflectors.legend_astray: A broken line and a cross: the beam would hit the hull there.
deflectors.legend_back: Dots: the way back from the exit.
